name: SIQ - Before / After Timeline
description: A vertical transformation journey timeline. Each step block has its own draggable before/after image slider, timeframe badge, description, and up to 3 stat chips. Features: zigzag or linear layout, animated progress line that fills as you scroll, step numbering, scroll-triggered entrance animations, and a CTA button. Complete color, typography, and spacing customization. Perfect for showing transformation progress over time.
author: SectionIQ
